name: Mechi
text: Mechi was a son of the Mórrígan. Per the Dindshenchas, Mac Cécht slew Mechi at the River Barrow. When the body was opened, Mechi proved to have three hearts, and each heart held a serpent. Left alive, those serpents could have brought disaster on Ireland. Mac Cécht burned the corpse and cast the ashes into the river, and so ended the threat.

key_results: Mechi was a son of the Mórrígan.
Mac Cécht killed him on the River Barrow, as the Dindshenchas tells it.
Three hearts were found in his body, each with a serpent inside.
Mac Cécht burned him and threw the ashes into the river.
The burning stopped the serpents from ruining Ireland.
